auth.loginSubtitle: Enter your credentials to access your exams.
auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, digit, and special character.
auth.forgotPasswordSubtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
auth.resetEmailSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link has been sent.
auth.resetPasswordSubtitle: Enter and confirm your new password below.
auth.passwordResetSuccess: Your password has been updated. You can now sign in.
auth.heroDescription: Access scheduled exams, track your progress, and view results — all in one secure portal.
auth.otpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.otpRequired: Two-factor authentication is required to sign in.

lobby.title: Exam lobby
lobby.description: Select a session below to begin your examination.
lobby.emptyDescription: There are no exam sessions scheduled for you at this time. Check back later or contact your administrator.

exam.question: Question
exam.confirmSubmit: Are you sure you want to submit? You cannot change answers after submission.
exam.unansweredWarning: You still have {{count}} unanswered question(s). You can submit anyway or return to complete them.

results.title: My results
results.description: Review scores and certificates from completed examinations.
results.detailDescription: Detailed breakdown of your examination performance.
results.certificateDescription: Congratulations — you earned a certificate for passing this examination.
results.emptyDescription: Complete an exam to see your scores here.
results.loadError: Unable to load your results. Please try again later.

profile.title: My profile
profile.description: Update your personal details and preferences.
profile.displayNameHint: Shown to proctors and support staff instead of your full name, if set.

support.title: Support
support.description: Get help from our support team.
support.subject: Subject
support.noMessagesDescription: This ticket does not have any messages yet.
support.emptyDescription: You haven't created any support tickets yet.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Stay up to date with announcements and account activity.
notifications.noAnnouncementsDescription: There are no active announcements right now.
notifications.emptyDescription: You're all caught up — new notifications will appear here.

security.title: Security
security.description: Manage two-factor authentication and trusted devices.
security.twoFactorDescription: Add an extra layer of security to your account using an authenticator app.
security.scanQrHint: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
security.backupCodesHint: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each one can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app.
security.noDevicesDescription: You have no signed-in devices on record.

certificates.title: Verify a certificate
certificates.description: Enter a certificate number or verification code to confirm its authenticity.
certificates.notFound: This certificate could not be found or has been revoked.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.success: Your email address has been verified. You can now sign in.
verifyEmail.missingToken: This verification link is invalid or has expired.

oauth.failed: We couldn't complete sign in. Please try again.

proctoring.title: Proctoring permissions required
proctoring.description: This exam uses full anti-cheating monitoring. Grant the permissions below before you continue. Signals are sent to live proctors and contribute to your integrity score.
proctoring.needWebcam: Webcam for face presence and multi-person detection
proctoring.needScreen: Screen share so your exam desktop can be monitored
proctoring.needGeo: Approximate location (used with IP checks for VPN / travel anomalies)
proctoring.screenRequired: Screen sharing is mandatory for this exam. If you stop sharing, a high-severity alert is raised.
proctoring.startFailed: Could not start proctoring media. Check browser permissions and try again.
proctoring.privacyNote: Video is processed locally for face detection where possible. Events and risk scores are shared with authorized proctors.
